Let $p \colon J(S, H) \to |H|$ be the universal compactified Jacobian, $L \subset |H|$ a general line, $J_L := p^{-1}(L)$...

declarations.lean_decl: noncomputable def phiMap (Z : paper.MW) : paper.N1 := paper.cl Z - paper.cl 0
declarations.name: phiMap

declarations.lean_decl: noncomputable def psiMap (Z : paper.MW) : paper.N1gen := paper.clGen Z - paper.clGen 0
declarations.name: psiMap

declarations.lean_decl: def itemLiftStatement : Prop := Function.Bijective restrictMap ∧ ∀ x y : paper.PicRig, restrictMap (x + y) = restrictMap x + restrictMap y

declarations.lean_decl: def mainThmHomStatement : Prop := ∀ x y : paper.MW, psiMap (x + y) = psiMap x + psiMap y
declarations.name: mainThmHomStatement

source_evidence.source_tex: The map $\psi\colon \MW(A/C) \to N_{1,\gen}(A)$ ... is a group homomorphism.

declarations.lean_decl: def mainThmKerStatement : Prop := ∀ Z : paper.MW, psiMap Z = 0 ↔ Z ∈ paper.torsion
